info.title: trash 2.6.0 - The Trash toolkit
info.description:
The Trash toolkit dispatcher. Provides trgen, trparse, trtree, and all other
Trash parse-tree manipulation tools under a single install.
Usage: trash <command> [options]  (e.g. trash trgen, trash gen, trash trparse)

options.name: --allstar
options.description: Use ALL(*) parser instead of Earley when --pinterp / --linterp are specified.

options.name: --dll
options.description: Search for parser in dll with this specified name.

options.name: --encoding
options.description: Set the encoding for the grammar.

options.name: --lib
options.description: Directory to search for .interp files (resolves relative --pinterp / --linterp paths).

options.name: --line
options.description: Include line/column information in parse tree.

options.name: --linterp
options.description: Path to lexer .interp file for ATN-based parsing.

options.name: --no-prs
options.description: Output parse errors only. No parsing result sets.

options.name: --parser
options.description: Location of pre-built parser (aka the trgen Generated/ directory)

options.name: --pinterp
options.description: Path to parser .interp file for ATN-based parsing.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Do not output anything; only set error code.

options.name: --read-file-name-stdin
options.description: Read input file names from stdin.

options.name: --type
options.description: Override type of parse. Use 'gen' to force the local Generated-CSharp parser regardless of file extension. Other values: ANTLRv4, ANTLRv3, ANTLRv2, Bison, Lark, rex, pegen_v3_10, LBNF, W3CEBNF, Xtext, Javacc, ABNF, Iso14977, Pegjs, Pest, Grammophone, Princeton.

options.name: --xf
options.description: Read input file names from file provided on command line.
